subject: DI04000171

body.en:
Definition

Interfacing is the electrical and logical adaptation that lets a controller communicate safely with an external device.

Explanation,application and checks

  • LED needs a current-limiting resistor;R≈(Vs−Vf−driver drop)/I.For an assumed5V,Vf2V,drop0.2V,I2mA,R≈1.4kΩ,choose a suitable higher standard value after checking brightness/ratings.
  • Active-low switch inputs are released HIGH then read;use approved bias,debounce and ESDprovisions.Afloating pin cannot give reliable state.
  • An active buzzer needs ON/OFFdrive;passive sounders need an appropriate alternating waveform/current driver.Arelay coil needs rated transistor/driver and a correct flyback/clamp path for DCcoils.
  • Boot outputs can momentarily differ from the application state.Design driver polarity/enable for safe reset;use low-voltage indicators only in this course,no household mains relay load.
Why a resistor per LED segment?

To limit each segment current independently and avoid uncontrolled current sharing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Interfacing controller/external device વચ્ચે સુરક્ષિત સંચાર માટે electrical/logical adaptation છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • LEDને resistor જોઈએ;R≈(Vs−Vf−driver drop)/I.ધારેલા5V,Vf2V,drop0.2V,I2mAથી R≈1.4kΩ મળે;brightness/ratings તપાસી યોગ્ય higher standard value લો.
  • Active-low switch input HIGH release કરીને વાંચો;approved bias,debounce/ESD લો.Floating pin reliable state આપતું નથી.
  • Active buzzerને ON/OFF drive;passive sounderને યોગ્ય alternating waveform/current driver જોઈએ.DC relay coil માટે rated driver/flyback-clamp જોઈએ.
  • Boot output applicationથી અલગ હોઈ શકે.Reset-safe polarity/enable design કરો.આ courseમાં low-voltage indicators જ,mains relay load નહીં.
દરેક Segmentનો Resistor કેમ?

દરેક segmentનો current independently મર્યાદિત કરવા.

body.en:
Definition

A7-segment display forms digits by energising selected light-emitting segments;common-cathode and common-anode describe the shared electrical terminal.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Use the specified bit order:bit0=a,1=b,2=c,3=d,4=e,5=f,6=g,7=dp.For common-cathode active-HIGH segments,the0–9table is3F,06,5B,4F,66,6D,7D,07,7F,6F(hex).
  • Construction:individual segment resistors,a compatible source/sink buffer and shared terminal appropriate to type;port pins alone must not supply an unverified array current.
  • Working:index a valid digit0..9,write its segment pattern,hold for a viewing interval,then update.Common-anode generally needs inverted active logic and a suitable sink arrangement;do not simply swap the common lead without redesign.
  • Multi-digit multiplexing also needs digit drivers,scan timing and peak/average current checks;the single-digit practical does not imply a complete multi-digit driver.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

7-segment display selected light-emitting segmentsથી digits બનાવે;common-cathode/common-anode shared terminalનો પ્રકાર બતાવે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Bit order0=a,1=b,2=c,3=d,4=e,5=f,6=g,7=dp રાખો.Common-cathode active-HIGH માટે0–9 table3F,06,5B,4F,66,6D,7D,07,7F,6F(hex) છે.
  • Constructionમાં દરેક segmentનો resistor,compatible source/sink buffer તથા type મુજબ common terminal છે.Unverified array current સીધી portથી નહીં.
  • Workingમાં valid digit0..9નું pattern લખો,viewing interval રાખી update કરો.Common-anodeમાં inverted logic/suitable sink arrangement જોઈએ;માત્ર common lead બદલી નદો.
  • Multi-digitમાં digit drivers,scan timing/peak-average current checks પણ જોઈએ.Single-digit practical complete multi-digit driver નથી.

body.en:
Definition

A16×2character LCD module displays two nominal rows of sixteen character positions using a controller that accepts commands and character data.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Assume a compatible HD44780-type5Vmodule in8-bit write-only mode:P2→D0..D7,RS=P3.0,E=P3.1,RW=0.VSS/VDD,contrast and backlight follow module specifications,not a guessed pin-current supply.
  • RS=0 selects a command;RS=1 selects character data.Present data,meet setup time,pulse Eand meet hold/execution times.RWgrounded means busy flag cannot be read.
  • Power-up sequence includes settling time and repeated function-set as required;common commands38H(8-bit/two-line),0CH(display on,cursor off),06H(entry increment),01H(clear),80H(first row),C0H(second row).
  • Clear/home take longer than many other commands;use the module’s limits or valid busy polling in a different RWwired design.Text strings must fit rows or be deliberately wrapped.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

16×2 character LCDમાં controller commands/character data લઈને nominal બે rowsમાં દરેક સોળ character positions બતાવે છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Compatible HD44780-type5V module8-bit write-only ધારો:P2→D0..D7,RS=P3.0,E=P3.1,RW=0.VSS/VDD,contrast/backlight module specification મુજબ.
  • RS=0 command/RS=1 character data છે.Data present કરી setup time,E pulse તથા hold/execution times પૂરા કરો.RW ground હોવાથી busy flag નથી વાંચી શકાતો.
  • Power-upમાં settling/repeated function-set જોઈએ;common commands38H(8-bit/two-line),0CH(display on,cursor off),06H(entry increment),01H(clear),80H(first row),C0H(second row).
  • Clear/home ઘણા commands કરતાં લાંબાં છે;module limits લો કે અલગ RW-wired designમાં busy polling કરો.String rowsમાં ફિટ થાય કે deliberate wrap કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A matrix keypad arranges switches between row and column conductors so that scanning identifies a row-column intersection with fewer pins than independent switches.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Use P1.0..3as rows and P1.4..7as released input columns;drive one row LOW and keep others released HIGH,then read columns under approved bias/driver conditions.
  • Avalid single column LOW identifies a key with the selected row;map its row/column to a character.Debounce requires stable repeated observations;wait for release or state tracking prevents uncontrolled repeat.
  • Multiple keys can create ghost paths without isolation diodes;reject ambiguous combinations or use a diode-aware design.Ablocking scan loop is unsuitable for time-critical motor protection.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
/* Classic 12T, 12 MHz. Timer0 owned here; nominal timing plus software overhead. */
void wait_ms(u16 n) {
    TMOD = (TMOD & 0xF0) | 0x01;
    while (n--) {
        TR0=0; TH0=0xFC; TL0=0x18; TF0=0; TR0=1;
        while (!TF0) { }
        TR0=0; TF0=0;
    }
}
const u8 code row_pattern[4]={0xFE,0xFD,0xFB,0xF7};
volatile u8 last_key=0xFF;
u8 scan_key(void) {
 u8 r,c,col,found=0xFF;
 for(r=0;r<4;r++) { P1=row_pattern[r]; wait_ms(1); col=(u8)((~P1>>4)&15);
  if(col) { if((col&(col-1)) || found!=0xFF) {P1=0xFF;return 0xFE;}
   for(c=0;c<4;c++) if(col==((u8)1<<c)) found=(u8)(4*r+c);
  }
 }
 P1=0xFF; return found;
}
void main(void) {u8 a,b,old=0xFF; P1=0xFF;
 for(;;) {a=scan_key();wait_ms(20);b=scan_key();
 if(a==b && b<16 && old==0xFF) last_key=b;
 if(a==b) old=b;
 } }
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Matrix keypadમાં switches row/column વચ્ચે હોય;scanningથી intersection ઓળખાય અને independent switches કરતાં ઓછી pins લાગે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • P1.0..3 rows/P1.4..7 released input columns લો;એક row LOW/બીજી HIGH release કરી columns વાંચો.
  • Selected row સાથે એક valid LOW columnથી key મળે;row/columnને characterમાં map કરો.Stable repeated observationથી debounce/release-state trackingથી uncontrolled repeat રોકો.
  • Diodes વિના multiple keysથી ghost paths બને;ambiguous combination reject કરો કે diode-aware design લો.Blocking scan time-critical motor protection માટે યોગ્ય નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ Standalone Keil C51 ઉદાહરણ

    }
}

 u8 r,c,col,found=0xFF;

   for(c=0;c<4;c++) if(col==((u8)1<<c)) found=(u8)(4*r+c);
  }
 }
 P1=0xFF; return found;
}
void main(void) {u8 a,b,old=0xFF; P1=0xFF;
 for(;;) {a=scan_key();wait_ms(20);b=scan_key();
 if(a==b && b<16 && old==0xFF) last_key=b;
 if(a==b) old=b;
 } }

h.en: DCmotor via L293D:construction and truth table
h.gu: L293D દ્વારા DC motor:Construction તથા Truth table

body.en:
Definition

An H-bridge reverses the voltage polarity across a load using controlled switching paths;L293D is a dual H-bridge driver with separate logic and motor-supply functions.

Explanation,application and checks

  • For a16pin L293D,1,2EN=1,1A=2,1Y=3,2Y=6,2A=7,VCC2=8,VCC1=16 and GND=4,5,12,13.Motor connects between1Y/2Y,not from an input pin to ground.
  • EN=0disables outputs;EN=1 and A/B=10or01give opposite directions;00or11make both outputs same state and can implement braking rather than free coasting.Verify board logic.
  • Use rated motor supply/common reference and decoupling;disable before reversing and allow mechanical settling.L293D includes clamp diodes but its600mA/channel rating is conditional,not an automatic stall-current limiter.
  • Choose a driver from stall current,voltage drop,dissipation and duty;the L293non-Dvariant needs the appropriate external inductive clamps.Never drive a motor directly from a port pin.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

H-bridge controlled pathsથી load voltage polarity ઉલટાવે;L293D separate logic/motor supplyવાળો dual H-bridge driver છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • 16pin L293Dમાં1,2EN=1,1A=2,1Y=3,2Y=6,2A=7,VCC2=8,VCC1=16/GND=4,5,12,13 છે.Motor1Y/2Y વચ્ચે જોડાય,inputથી ground નહીં.
  • EN=0 outputs disable;EN=1 સાથે A/B=10/01 વિરુદ્ધ direction આપે;00/11માં બંને same state હોવાથી braking થઈ શકે,free coasting નહીં.Board logic તપાસો.
  • Rated supply/common reference/decoupling લો;reverse પહેલાં disable/mechanical settling કરો.L293Dમાં clamp diodes છે,પણ600mA/channel conditional rating છે,automatic stall-current limiter નહીં.
  • Stall current,drop,dissipation/dutyથી driver પસંદ કરો.L293 non-Dમાં યોગ્ય external clamps જોઈએ.Motor સીધી portથી નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A stepper motor advances through discrete commanded rotor positions when its windings are energised in the correct sequence;open-loop step count is not proof that every physical step occurred.

Explanation,application and checks

  • For an approved unipolar trainer,use buffered P2.0..3outputs through a rated ULN2003-type driver with correct winding supply/common and clamp connection.Abare quasi-bidirectional HIGH may not supply the driver input current reliably.
  • Two-phase full-step sequence03H→06H→0CH→09His valid only for the assumed mapped coils;reverse table order for reverse rotation.Wave-drive and half-step sequences differ in torque/current/resolution.
  • If step angle is1.8°,ideal steps/revolution=360/1.8=200.Commanding50steps ideally gives90°before gearing;missed steps/backlash/load and homing affect actual position.
  • Use low initial speed,ramp where needed,travel limits and thermal/current checks.Bipolar windings require suitable bidirectional current drivers,not the same unipolar connection.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stepper motor correct winding sequenceથી discrete commanded positionsમાં આગળ વધે;open-loop count દરેક physical step થયો તેનો પુરાવો નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • Approved unipolar trainerમાં buffered P2.0..3,ULN2003-type driver,winding supply/common/clamp લો.Bare quasi-bidirectional HIGH driver input current પૂરતો નઆપી શકે.
  • Assumed coil mapping માટે two-phase full-step03H→06H→0CH→09H છે;reverse orderથી reverse થાય.Wave-drive/half-step torque,current/resolutionમાં અલગ છે.
  • Step angle1.8° હોય તો ideal360/1.8=200steps/revolution.50stepsથી gearing પહેલાં nominal90°;missed steps/backlash/load/homing actual position બદલે.
  • Low initial speed,જરૂર મુજબ ramp,travel limits/thermal-current checks લો.Bipolar windingsને suitable bidirectional driver જોઈએ,સમાન unipolar wiring નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

ADC0804 is an8-bit successive-approximation analog-to-digital converter with a parallel data interface and conversion-control signals.

Explanation,application and checks

  • For the20pin device:CS1,RD 2,WR 3,CLKIN 4,INTR 5,VIN+6,VIN−7,A GND 8,VREF/2=9,D GND 10,D7..D0=11..18,CLKR 19,VCC2 0.Verify the actual package and module.
  • Trainer pin map:P1→D0..D7,RD=P3.7,WR=P3.6,INTR=P3.2,CS LOW.Release P1=FFHfor input;provide a valid clock,reference,grounds,decoupling and input conditioning.
  • With RD HIGH,pulse WR LOW then HIGH to start;wait for INTR LOW with a bounded timeout,drive RD LOW,meet access time,read the byte,then return RD HIGH.The signal must remain valid during conversion.
  • VREF/2sets half the intended full-scale span;default/open reference and clock details follow the datasheet.TIspecifies about103µstypical at640kHzwith66–73clock periods;do not insist it is exactly64clock cycles.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

ADC0804 parallel data interface તથા conversion-control signalsવાળો8-bit successive-approximation ADC છે.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • 20pin માટે CS1,RD 2,WR 3,CLKIN 4,INTR 5,VIN+6,VIN−7,A GND 8,VREF/2=9,D GND 10,D7..D0=11..18,CLKR 19,VCC2 0 છે.Actual package/module તપાસો.
  • Trainer map:P1→D0..D7,RD=P3.7,WR=P3.6,INTR=P3.2,CS LOW.P1=FFH release કરો;clock,reference,ground,decoupling/conditioning આપો.
  • RD HIGH રાખી WR LOW→HIGHથી start કરો;bounded timeout સાથે INTR LOWની રાહ,RD LOW/access time પછી byte read/RD HIGH કરો.Conversion દરમિયાન input valid રહેવું જોઈએ.
  • VREF/2 intended full-scale spanનો અડધો ભાગ નક્કી કરે;default/open reference/clock datasheet મુજબ.TI640kHz પર આશરે103µs typical/66–73clock periods આપે;exact64cycles નલખો.

body.en:
Definition

Resolution is the analog input increment corresponding to one ideal ADC code step;quantisation is distinct from reference,sensor,offset and noise error.

Assumptions,ordered derivation and checks

  1. An8-bit converter has2^8=256codes0..255.For an assumed unipolar span VFS,the ideal step q=VFS/256 and approximate input reconstruction Vin≈Dq.Maximum reconstructed code255gives255q,not exactly VFS.
  2. LM35 nominal slope S=10mV/°C,so T≈Dq/S.With VFS=2.56V,q=10mVand T≈D°C;with VFS=5.00V,q=19.53125mVand T≈1.953125D°C.
  3. At assumed35°C,LM35 output≈0.350V.With2.56Vspan the ideal code is about35;with5.00Vspan it is about18 and reconstructs35.15625°C.These are calculated expectations,not measured accuracy.
  4. Single-ended positive-supply demonstrations do not claim negative temperature measurement.Supply,package pinout,reference loading,calibration and permissible sensor range must be checked.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Resolution એક ideal ADC code step જેટલું analog increment છે;quantisation/reference,sensor,offset/noise errorsથી અલગ છે.

ધારણાઓ,ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation તથા ચકાસણી

  1. 8-bit converterમાં2^8=256codes0..255 છે.Assumed unipolar span VFS માટે q=VFS/256 તથા Vin≈Dq.Code255થી255q મળે,exact VFS નહીં.
  2. LM35 nominal S=10mV/°C છે,તેથી T≈Dq/S.VFS=2.56Vમાં q=10mV/T≈D°C;VFS=5.00Vમાં q=19.53125mV/T≈1.953125D°C.
  3. Assumed35°C પર LM35≈0.350V.2.56V spanમાં ideal code આશરે35;5.00Vમાં આશરે18થી35.15625°C reconstruction થાય.આ calculated expectation છે,measured accuracy નહીં.
  4. Single-ended positive-supply demo negative temperature માપવાનો દાવો નથી.Supply,package pinout,reference loading,calibration/permissible range તપાસો.

body.en:
Definition

Displaying an analog value means acquiring a valid digital sample,scaling it into engineering units,formatting text and updating a display without presenting invalid samples as real readings.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Use ADC data=P1 and LCD data=P2;ADC control=P3.2/3.6/3.7,LCD RS/E=P3.0/3.1.These maps can coexist only when UART/external memory functions are not simultaneously assigned to those same pins.
  • For2.56Vspan and LM35,display Dwith the°Cunit under the declared nominal scaling.Avoid floating-point formatting on a small baseline device when integer/fixed-point units suffice.
  • After a timeout show ADC ERRand keep the defined safe control state;do not keep an old value on screen without marking it stale.Limit display updates so control/interrupt work is not starved.

Complete standalone Keil C51 example

12 MHz classic12T

#include <reg51.h>
typedef unsigned char u8;
typedef unsigned int u16;
/* Classic 12T, 12 MHz. Timer0 owned here; nominal timing plus software overhead. */
void wait_ms(u16 n) {
    TMOD = (TMOD & 0xF0) | 0x01;
    while (n--) {
        TR0=0; TH0=0xFC; TL0=0x18; TF0=0; TR0=1;
        while (!TF0) { }
        TR0=0; TF0=0;
    }
}
sbit ADC_RD=P3^7;
sbit ADC_WR=P3^6;
sbit ADC_INTR=P3^2;
/* ADC data=P1; CS tied LOW; stable conditioned input and valid clock/reference. */
u8 adc_read(u8 *value) {
    u16 timeout=60000u;
    P1=0xFF; ADC_INTR=1; ADC_RD=1;
    ADC_WR=0; wait_ms(1); ADC_WR=1;
    while (ADC_INTR && timeout) { --timeout; }
    if (!timeout) return 0;
    ADC_RD=0; wait_ms(1); *value=P1; ADC_RD=1;
    return 1;
}
sbit LCD_RS=P3^0;
sbit LCD_E=P3^1;
/* HD44780-compatible 8-bit write-only module: D0..7=P2, RW=GND. */
void lcd_send(u8 x,u8 is_data) {
    LCD_RS=is_data; P2=x; LCD_E=0; wait_ms(1);
    LCD_E=1; wait_ms(1); LCD_E=0; wait_ms(2);
}
void lcd_cmd(u8 x) { lcd_send(x,0); }
void lcd_data(u8 x) { lcd_send(x,1); }
void lcd_text(char *s) { while (*s) lcd_data((u8)*s++); }
void lcd_init(void) {
    LCD_E=0; wait_ms(40);
    lcd_cmd(0x30); wait_ms(5); lcd_cmd(0x30); lcd_cmd(0x30);
    lcd_cmd(0x38); lcd_cmd(0x08); lcd_cmd(0x01);
    lcd_cmd(0x06); lcd_cmd(0x0C);
}
void lcd_u8(u8 x) {
    lcd_data((u8)('0'+x/100)); lcd_data((u8)('0'+(x/10)%10));
    lcd_data((u8)('0'+x%10));
}
void main(void) { u8 sample; lcd_init();
 for(;;) { lcd_cmd(0x80);
 if(adc_read(&sample)) {lcd_text("T=");lcd_u8(sample);lcd_text(" C       ");}
 else lcd_text("ADC ERROR       ");
 wait_ms(200);
 } }
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Analog value displayમાં valid digital sample લેવું,engineering unitsમાં scale કરવું,text format/LCD update કરવું આવે;invalid sampleને real reading તરીકે નબતાવો.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • ADC data=P1/LCD data=P2;ADC control=P3.2/3.6/3.7,LCD RS/E=P3.0/3.1 લો.Same pins પર UART/external memory assign ન હોય ત્યારે જ coexist થાય.

title.gu: પ્રવૃત્તિ b: 8051 Micro-project Design તથા Simulation

body.en:
Aim and status

A source-suggested learning/report plan,not an already completed workshop,visit or project.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Choose LED pattern,temperature monitor or low-voltage motor controller;state a testable requirement,pin map,clock and safe output state before writing firmware.
  • Prepare flowchart,complete source,build log,normal/boundary/fault test cases and genuine simulator evidence.Afailing test is a finding,not a reason to fabricate a successful snapshot.
  • Prepare about five pages:aim/scope;verified component/software background;diagram/code/method;actual evidence and test interpretation;conclusion,limitations and references.
  • Keep name/date,device/clock,firmware revision,expected versus actual results,source URLs,evidence filenames and teacher feedback blank until collected.Never invent readings or signatures.
body.gu:
હેતુ તથા સ્થિતિ

Source-suggested learning/report plan છે,completed workshop,visit/project નથી.

સમજણ,ઉપયોગ તથા ચકાસણી

  • LED pattern,temperature monitor કે low-voltage motor controller લો;firmware પહેલાં testable requirement,pin map,clock/safe output લખો.
  • Flowchart,full source,build log,normal/boundary/fault tests તથા genuine simulator evidence આપો.Failed test finding છે,fake successful snapshotનું કારણ નહીં.
  • આશરે પાંચ pages:aim/scope;verified background;diagram/code/method;actual evidence/test interpretation;conclusion,limitations/references.
  • Name/date,device/clock,firmware revision,expected/actual results,source URLs,evidence files/teacher feedback data મળે ત્યાં સુધી blank રાખો.Readings/signatures નબનાવો.

title.en: Activity c: Workshop,hackathon and hardware-session plan

body.en:
Aim and status

A source-suggested learning/report plan,not an already completed workshop,visit or project.

Explanation,application and checks

  • Use an authorised PC B/interface/serial project with assigned roles,schematic review and isolated current-limited power;no attendance,photos or participation certificate are prefilled.
  • Record actual team decisions,solder/connection inspection,tool settings,fault isolation and each person’s contribution only after genuine participation;retain mentor approval.
  • Prepare about five pages:aim/scope;verified component/software background;diagram/code/method;actual evidence and test interpretation;conclusion,limitations and references.
  • Keep name/date,device/clock,firmware revision,expected versus actual results,source URLs,evidence filenames and teacher feedback blank until collected.Never invent readings or signatures.
